reason: This is a regulatory/supervisory policy document: the SEC and the French AMF announced a Memorandum of Understanding on consultation and information-sharing for investment advisers, investment companies and investment service providers, and the SEC stated it will resume processing registration applications from AMF-supervised asset management companies. It names only government regulators (SEC, AMF), no companies or tickers, so companies and symbols are left empty; relevance is to financial-sector supervision in the US and EU.
